SHENSHEN-FORM_POWER.title: Girl Form
SHENSHEN-FORM_POWER.description: Use your girl deck. Transformation preserves HP, Energy, Block and powers.
SHENSHEN-FORM_POWER.catDescription: Use your cat deck. Transformation preserves HP, Energy, Block and powers.
SHENSHEN-FORM_POWER.smartDescription: Transforming discards the old form's exclusive hand cards and draws the same number from the new form. Preserve HP, Energy, Block and powers.
SHENSHEN-FORM_SHIFT_POWER.title: Transformation Echo
SHENSHEN-FORM_SHIFT_POWER.description: Claw Strike hits 4 times this turn.
SHENSHEN-FORM_SHIFT_POWER.smartDescripti: Claw Strike hits 4 times this turn.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_MARK_POWER.title: Light Mark
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_MARK_POWER.description:
Each attack hit from the applier adds {BurnDamage} burn damage. {Turns} of their turns remain.
Burn can be blocked and ignores Strength and Vulnerable.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_MARK_POWER.smartDescripti: Each attack hit from the applier adds fixed burn damage. Burn can be blocked and ignores Strength and Vulnerable.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_BLESSING_POWER.title: Light Blessing
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_BLESSING_POWER.descriptio: Before your next normal draw, choose {Amount} extra cards from your draw pile to add to hand.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_BLESSING_POWER.smartDescr: Before your next normal draw, choose extra cards from your draw pile to add to hand.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_BLESSING_POWER.selectionS: Choose {Amount} extra cards to add to hand.
SHENSHEN-CAT_DODGE_POWER.title: Mew Dodge
SHENSHEN-CAT_DODGE_POWER.description: Dodge the first hit of the first enemy multi-hit attack.
SHENSHEN-CAT_DODGE_POWER.smartDescriptio: Dodge the first hit of the first enemy multi-hit attack.
SHENSHEN-FLUFFED_UP_POWER.title: Fluffed Up
SHENSHEN-FLUFFED_UP_POWER.description: After activation, the first enemy attack hit that causes HP loss grants 3 Thorns.
SHENSHEN-FLUFFED_UP_POWER.smartDescripti: After activation, the first enemy attack hit that causes HP loss grants 3 Thorns.
SHENSHEN-FLUFFED_UP_POWER.upgradedDescri:
After activation, the first enemy attack hit that causes HP loss grants 3 Thorns. Each later hit that causes HP loss grants 1.
Each successful enemy debuff application grants 1 Thorns.
SHENSHEN-SHATTERED_MIRROR_POWER.title: Shattered Mirror
SHENSHEN-SHATTERED_MIRROR_POWER.descript: {Amount} mirror Block remains. It reflects the attack damage it blocks. Expires on your next turn.
SHENSHEN-SHATTERED_MIRROR_POWER.smartDes: Only Block supplied by Shattered Mirror reflects attack damage. Expires on your next turn.
SHENSHEN-TEMPORARY_DEXTERITY_POWER.title: Temporary Dexterity
SHENSHEN-TEMPORARY_DEXTERITY_POWER.descr: Lose this {Amount} Dexterity at the start of your next turn.
SHENSHEN-TEMPORARY_DEXTERITY_POWER.smart: Temporary Dexterity expires at the start of your next turn.
SHENSHEN-TEMPORARY_THORNS_POWER.title: Temporary Thorns
SHENSHEN-TEMPORARY_THORNS_POWER.descript: Lose this {Amount} Thorns at the start of your next turn.
SHENSHEN-TEMPORARY_THORNS_POWER.smartDes: Temporary Thorns expires at the start of your next turn.
SHENSHEN-CURIOUS_PEEK_POWER.title: Curious Echo
SHENSHEN-CURIOUS_PEEK_POWER.description: After your next transformation this turn, draw {Amount} extra card(s).
SHENSHEN-CURIOUS_PEEK_POWER.smartDescrip: Draw extra cards after your next transformation this turn.
